title: Design of Automotive Steering Gear (Recirculating Ball Type)
subject: PCC303-MEC

courseOutcome.statement: Design power screws, steering gears, and power transmission mechanisms by applying kinematics, torque multiplication, rolling contact mechanics, and efficiency criteria for reliable automotive operation.

client: Automotive Chassis Engineering Division — Steering Gear & Linkage Design

tasks.title: Understand Automotive Steering Gear and Recirculating-Ball Mechanism
Identify Steering Gear Components and Mechanism Interfaces
Understand Recirculating-Ball Working Principle and Friction Reduction
Determine Ball-Nut Axial Motion and Kinematic Transformation
Establish Steering Gear Design Data and Geometric Parameters
Calculate Worm Lead, Ball-Nut Axial Travel, and Lock-to-Lock Stroke
Understand Rack-and-Sector Engagement and Angular Output
Calculate Overall Steering Ratio, Output Torque, and Pitman Arm Force
Evaluate Complete Kinematic Transmission Sequence and Motion Path
Engineering Assessment, Contact Stress, Backlash & Safety Verification
Automotive Recirculating-Ball Steering Gear Technical Report
